methodology.clock: process.hrtime.bigint monotonic wall time around spawnSync
methodology.limitation: No common reliable internal clock API is available. Startup baseline is separate and is never subtracted.
methodology.scheduling: Sequential cases; engine order rotates each warmup/sample; warmups launch fresh processes and are excluded from summaries. Result checkpoints occur outside timed launches.
methodology.persistence: Atomic results.json replacement after each trial/workload; status remains running until final provenance checks finish.
methodology.percentile: Nearest rank: sorted[ceil(0.95 * N) - 1]. With fewer than 20 samples p95 is the maximum.
methodology.solxLimits: Default interpreter limits; no unlimited-steps or increased-depth flags.

runtimeEnvironment.policy: Clear LUA_INIT/LUA_PATH/LUA_CPATH and all version-suffixed variants for runtime launches and version probes; inherit other variables without recording their values.
runtimeEnvironment.imports: Lua/LuaJIT search only the helper fixture directory; Luau uses a relative helper path.
